scope: Original Code128 encoding, actual physical label raycasts, authored rack-bin geometry, box support and a populated sleeping-stock fixture in isolated PhysX. No native browser input or rendered UI is simulated by these checks.
checks: Code128-B known vector has start104, weighted checksum11 and stop106
Known vector has90 modules before quiet zones
All standard symbol widths and the13-module stop are valid
Empty, control and non-ASCII payloads are rejected
A changed checksum is not accepted as a readable label
Roundtrip preserves BIN:A01-01-01
Roundtrip preserves CARTON:CTN-000126
Roundtrip preserves ITEM:TAPE-48
Empty career registers its six physical bins without creating stock
Bin installation grants no inventory
A front-facing printed barcode reads its exact carton identity
The separate side label reads the actual SKU for item lookup
Inbound carton labels can carry their actual purchase-order reference
Actual three-line carton text stays within its paper and clear of the barcode
Plain cardboard is not a barcode target
A solid wall blocks the label behind it
A carton cannot be scanned through its back
An almost edge-on label is rejected
A label beyond the4.2m operating range is rejected
A label inside the minimum focus distance is rejected
A bin volume does not hide its physical barcode
Floor-bin labels face upward and scan from standing height
A settled whole carton on the floor is physically in its selected bin
A carton outside its bin cannot be confirmed
An unsupported carton in the bin volume is not put away
Carrier-restrained stock cannot be received by a volume alone
Moving stock must settle before confirmation
All18 authored wall-rack positions become bins; the six low faces are pickable
Sandbox has90 unique rack-bin addresses and30 reachable low faces across rows A to E
Every rack bin has an explicit non-solid storage volume and capacity
100 varied cartons remain supported in their real rack bins
Settled populated stock sleeps while remaining dynamic and hand-pickable
Sandbox cartons retain eight physical package sizes
Every carton has a carry marker, two carton barcodes and a side item barcode
Measured print fits every carton size and rack/floor label without crossing barcode stripes
WMS geometry and labels add no lights
Dispatch is a real moving bin attached to the van deck
